data.name: Tobaron
data.long_meaning: Tobaron is a Hebrew name derived from Tobias, which means 'God is good'. Tobias is a biblical figure who is a central character in the Book of Tobit. He is a brave, pious man who overcomes many challenges and ultimately finds true love with the woman Sarah. The name Tobaron carries with it the strength and wisdom of Tobias, as well as the deep spiritual significance of his journey in the Bible.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with hope, faith, and love, Tobaron reminds us of the power of God's goodness in our lives.

in_hebrew.name: טובארון
in_hebrew.meaning: טוב ארון בן אלוהים משמעותו טוב ויפה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טובארון הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'טוב ארון בן אלוהים' או 'הטוב והיפה'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'טוב' שמשמעותו 'טוב' או 'יפה', ו'ארון' שיכול להיות קיצור של 'ארונו' או 'ארון האלוקים', שמשמעותו 'ארון האל' או 'קודש'. השם נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה ויכול לשמש כתזכורת לטוב וליפה שבחיים.

in_greek.name: Τωβαρων
in_greek.long_meaning: Τωβαρων είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'καλό και όμορφο' ή 'καλός και δίκαιος'. Το όνομα αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'Τωβ' που σημαίνει 'καλό' και 'αaron' που σημαίνει 'αρών' ή 'ορφανός'. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την καλοσύνη και τη δικαιοσύνη.

historical_references.reference: Tobaron was the name of a 4th-century Roman nobleman and soldier who, after converting to Christianity, was appointed military commander of the city of Constantinople by Emperor Constantine I. During a Persian invasion, Tobaron successfully defended the city and earned the title 'Defender of the Faith'.

Another Tobaron is mentioned in the 'Historia de Preliis' by Geoffrey of Villehardouin, an 11th-century chronicler, as the leader of the Latin forces during the Second Crusade. He is said to have captured the city of Acre from the Saracens with great success.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Names are not inherently meaningful in themselves, but rather the meanings are derived from the cultural, historical, or symbolic contexts in which they are used. In the case of Tobaron, I would suggest that it is a variation of the biblical name Tobias, meaning "God is good." However, in a more symbolic or spiritual sense, Tobaron could be seen as a reminder of God's goodness and faithfulness in our lives, even in the midst of difficulties or challenges. Tobaron may also be interpreted as a call to trust in God's provision and guidance, as Tobias did in the biblical story when he was led by the angel Raphael on a dangerous journey.
